summary: PowerShell masking rules match Python; Ansible.Basic registers no_log values, masks its event log messages, and returns new secrets to the controller.
questions: Does Ansible.Basic mask no_log values in the Windows event log?

answer_card.title: Ansible.Basic masking behavior
answer_card.answer_md: Yes. Matching rules are the same as Python. `Ansible.Basic` auto-registers `no_log` values, masks messages written to the event log, and returns newly registered secrets to the controller on exit.
